title: Origin story: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
t: Origin story: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
description: Dr. Henry Jekyll, respectable London gentleman, devised a drug to separate his good and evil natures — and loosed Edward Hyde, the pure evil self, small and ape-like, who trampled a child and murdered Sir Danvers Carew. The transformations grew involuntary; Jekyll's letter confesses all before the final change.
